ztp_rules.definition: Stating factually incorrect information about the programme, curriculum, or delivery model.
ztp_rules.trigger_text: Any programme fact stated that contradicts the approved Knowledge Base.
ztp_rules.example_text: Describing a self-paced programme as fully live, or misstating the delivery model.

ztp_rules.definition: Promising or implying a guaranteed placement, job, or specific salary outcome.
ztp_rules.trigger_text: Counselor states or implies a guaranteed job, placement, or salary figure.
ztp_rules.example_text: "You will definitely get a 40% hike after this programme."

ztp_rules.definition: Deliberately or materially misstating eligibility criteria.
ztp_rules.trigger_text: Eligibility criteria stated contradicts the approved Knowledge Base.
ztp_rules.example_text: Telling an ineligible applicant they qualify.

ztp_rules.definition: Quoting incorrect fees or unauthorized discounts/payment routes.
ztp_rules.trigger_text: Any fee figure or payment instruction not present in the approved Knowledge Base.
ztp_rules.example_text: Quoting a fee or discount not in the official fee structure.

ztp_rules.definition: Disclosing an applicant's personal or academic data to an unauthorized party.
ztp_rules.trigger_text: Sharing applicant data with anyone not authorized to receive it.
ztp_rules.example_text: Sharing an applicant's phone number or documents with an unrelated third party.

ztp_rules.definition: Failing to disclose that the call may be recorded, where policy requires it.
ztp_rules.trigger_text: No recording disclosure given during the opening of the call.
ztp_rules.example_text: Call proceeds without informing the applicant the call is/may be recorded.

ztp_rules.definition: Encouraging document fabrication, alteration, concealment, or unofficial payment collection.
ztp_rules.trigger_text: Counselor suggests falsifying documents or collecting payment outside official channels.
ztp_rules.example_text: "Just show a different experience letter," or asking for a personal bank transfer.

ztp_rules.definition: Any abusive, threatening, or discriminatory language or behaviour toward an applicant.
ztp_rules.trigger_text: Counselor uses abusive, threatening, or discriminatory language.
ztp_rules.example_text: Derogatory remarks, raised voice, or discriminatory comments toward an applicant.

kpi_definitions.name: Overall Quality Score
kpi_definitions.definition: Average overall audit score across all submitted audits in the period.

kpi_definitions.name: Compliance Score
kpi_definitions.definition: Average score on the Compliance category.
kpi_definitions.formula: AVG(Compliance category score / category max) x 100

kpi_definitions.name: Fatal Error %
kpi_definitions.definition: Share of audited calls with a confirmed ZTP (fatal) violation.

kpi_definitions.name: Error-Free Call %
kpi_definitions.definition: Share of audits with no MINOR or MAJOR errors and no ZTP.
kpi_definitions.formula: COUNT(audits with zero error_records) / COUNT(audits) x 100

kpi_definitions.name: Average Audit Score
kpi_definitions.definition: Mean overall score across all submitted audits (same base measure as Overall Quality Score, tracked separately per the brief).

kpi_definitions.name: Coaching Effectiveness %
kpi_definitions.definition: Share of closed coaching actions with a verified score improvement on follow-up audit.
kpi_definitions.formula: COUNT(closed actions with verified_improvement=1) / COUNT(closed actions) x 100

kpi_definitions.name: Repeat Error %
kpi_definitions.definition: Share of logged errors that are repeats of a prior error for the same counselor.

kpi_definitions.name: Knowledge Score
kpi_definitions.definition: Average score on the Guidance category (programme/eligibility/fee knowledge).
kpi_definitions.formula: AVG(Guidance category score / category max) x 100

kpi_definitions.name: Communication Score
kpi_definitions.definition: Average score on the Communication category.
kpi_definitions.formula: AVG(Communication category score / category max) x 100

kpi_definitions.name: Documentation Score
kpi_definitions.definition: Average score on the Closure category (CRM documentation, disposition, follow-up).
kpi_definitions.formula: AVG(Closure category score / category max) x 100

kpi_definitions.name: Applicant Experience Score
kpi_definitions.definition: Average score on the Applicant Experience category.
kpi_definitions.formula: AVG(Applicant Experience category score / category max) x 100

kpi_definitions.name: Calibration Variance %
kpi_definitions.definition: Average absolute variance between auditor and reviewer scores, as a % of max score.

kpi_definitions.name: Audit Coverage %
kpi_definitions.definition: Share of active counselors who received at least one audit in the period.
kpi_definitions.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT audited counselors) / COUNT(active counselors) x 100
